agree.reason: The doubled gift and concrete $575-per-child figure give a lapsed donor a clear reason to act, but someone still sore about Eastside gets only a brief acknowledgement and no reason to trust the school again, so many will stay away.

honest.reason: The draft rightly drops the brief's false claim that a gift guarantees every waiting child a place, but it inflates 'a few' angry notes to 'many of you told us' and invents the rule that a family gets a yes only once the money is in hand.

works_the_facts.reason: Its figures check out: $575 matched pays for one child's $1,150 year, and the average $85 gift becomes $170. It never gives the $70,150 total gap, or the fact that even a fully used match ($30,000) places only about 26 of the 61 children.

right_comparison.reason: What happens without a gift (children keep waiting, and the match goes unused after December 31) is only implied, and the draft never says how far last year's $1,240 falls short of what is needed.

qualification.reason: The match is properly limited to returning donors, dollar for dollar, up to $15,000 by December 31, and a January report is promised, but it never says what happens to the children if the match isn't reached.

objections.reason: The Eastside closure is named and respected, but the draft doesn't explain why it happened or what has changed, and 'I'm not asking you to [forget]' asks the angry reader to set the grievance aside rather than answering it.

fit.reason: It is a year-end appeal of about 200 words, signed by the executive director with a clear call to action; it leaves out the requested guarantee wording, which was the right call because that wording would have been false.
